_README: SCENARIO ONLY. Placeholder rates used to demonstrate engine output. NOT verified. Do not quote.

codFeeChargedToCustomer.note: Confirmed live: shippingLine 'Cash on Delivery' = 50.00 on every COD order in the last 25.

prepaidShippingChargedToCustomer.note: Confirmed live: shippingLine 'Standard' = 0.00. Prepaid ships free.

gatewayPercent.note: Typical Indian gateway rate for domestic cards/UPI. CONFIRM against an actual Razorpay/Shopify Payments settlement statement. UPI is often 0% and cards ~2%, so a blended rate is more accurate if the mix is known.

gatewayGstPercent.note: GST charged ON the gateway fee, not on the order. Standard 18% on financial services.

shipping.note: Confirmed live: 22 of last 25 orders carry Delhivery AWBs (59152210xxxxxx series) with direct delhivery.com tracking URLs. The Shiprocket service in shipping-integration/ is NOT the live path.

forwardFreightFallback.note: Per-AWB actual billed freight. Populate from the Delhivery One MCP or a Delhivery billing CSV. Until then the engine refuses to invent a number and marks the order freight_unknown.

rtoFreightMultiplier.note: RTO return leg billed at the same rate as forward. Delhivery commonly bills RTO at 100% of forward; some contracts bill 80%. CONFIRM from a billing statement showing an RTO line.

codRemittanceFee.note: Delhivery COD collection charge. Typically higher of a flat fee or a percent of COD value. CONFIRM the exact contracted numbers from a Delhivery invoice.

Tirupati.note: 2 of last 25 orders (#1129, #1120) went via 'Other' / Tirupati Courier. These will have NO Delhivery AWB and will never resolve against the Delhivery MCP. They need manual cost entry or exclusion.

inputCreditOnCogs.note: Whether supplier invoices from Fabrizo Market carry GST that can be claimed as input credit. Changes effective COGS materially.

fixedMonthly._note: Everything billed monthly regardless of order count. Ashish must fill. These are what turn a positive contribution margin into an actual loss.

adSpend._note: Pulled live from the Meta Ads MCP per period. Not stored here. Reel boost campaigns are offline-sales only and must be excluded from online P&L attribution.

dataQualityFlags: Most products have weight 0 in Shopify. Delhivery bills on actual or volumetric weight, whichever is higher. With no declared weight there is no way to detect weight-discrepancy overbilling, which is the single most common silent margin leak in Indian D2C.
Kohra and Latkan are set to 0.6 GRAMS. Almost certainly meant to be 0.6 KILOGRAMS. A real data bug.
The 'Partial Payment' 0.00 product is still ACTIVE. It is a payment mechanism, not stock, and is excluded from COGS by the engine.
Some variants have sku: null (Anaar, Bandhan, Darpan, Morani and others). SKU-level cost attribution falls back to product title for these.
